args.statement:
The sealed rejection is reproducible against the owner databases that actually produced it. The earlier sealed-guard oracle replayed case-3, which already contained a refreshed DELIVER from an earlier run; the rejection receipts were produced from case-1 (WITHOUT) and case-2 (WITH). In those real owner states the prior DELIVER (episode-e7050e9ddf64ccebde7f08f6) is followed by the "Fleet rollout verification" note and names service/test/MIGRATION artifacts, not MAINTENANCE-REVIEW.md. The guard therefore refused twice: "a journal fact was recorded after the DELIVER conclusion", then "the direct commit touches no artifact named by the DELIVER conclusion".

Commit 9c7c3d2 makes the guard reproduce and survive that state without inventing a new judgement. It still refreshes only an EXISTING principal DELIVER. It now treats only NEGATIVE_RESULT/OPEN_QUESTION, structured decision/delegation records, or a resolved conclusion as reopening; a plain later verification note is carried into the refreshed statement and evidenceRefs. When the new HEAD is the tip of another local branch (the ordinary fast-forward of a prepared review), the refresh may name the review paths that merge added, unioned with the principal's previously named artifacts. The principal's statement is copied unchanged with a transparent suffix; nothing is accepted, promoted or advanced. The sealed oracle now uses case-1/case-2 and checks both the later note and the prior conclusion's missing review path; both arms produce exactly one DELIVER at the receipt commits (d6e5558 WITHOUT, b5835cd WITH) with matching blobs, the control arm records nothing, and the synthetic guard test adds prepared-review, later-note, ordinary-commit and resolved-conclusion controls.

Verification: sealed guard 22/22 checks over both arms; direct-guard oracle 13/13; control 6/6; delivery-artifacts 12/12; delivery-required 12/12; pulse 7/7; readiness 6/6; tsc build clean; vitest pnwf_direct_guard 3/3 and alhs_episode_convergence 13/13. Limit: this preserves an existing principal DELIVER and records the review paths a prepared merge added. It still cannot create a delivery for a project with no prior DELIVER, and operator acceptance plus the canonical-head decision remain outside the product.

The sealed rejection is reproducible against the owner databases that actually produced it. The earlier sealed-guard oracle replayed case-3, which already contained a refreshed DELIVER from an earlier run; the rejection receipts were produced from case-1 (WITHOUT) and case-2 (WITH). In those real owner states the prior DELIVER (episode-e7050e9ddf64ccebde7f08f6) is followed by the "Fleet rollout verification" note and names service/test/MIGRATION artifacts, not MAINTENANCE-REVIEW.md. The guard therefore refused twice: "a journal fact was recorded after the DELIVER conclusion", then "the direct commit touches no artifact named by the DELIVER conclusion".

Commit 9c7c3d2 makes the guard reproduce and survive that state without inventing a new judgement. It still refreshes only an EXISTING principal DELIVER. It now treats only NEGATIVE_RESULT/OPEN_QUESTION, structured decision/delegation records, or a resolved conclusion as reopening; a plain later verification note is carried into the refreshed statement and evidenceRefs. When the new HEAD is the tip of another local branch (the ordinary fast-forward of a prepared review), the refresh may name the review paths that merge added, unioned with the principal's previously named artifacts. The principal's statement is copied unchanged with a transparent suffix; nothing is accepted, promoted or advanced. The sealed oracle now uses case-1/case-2 and checks both the later note and the prior conclusion's missing review path; both arms produce exactly one DELIVER at the receipt commits (d6e5558 WITHOUT, b5835cd WITH) with matching blobs, the control arm records nothing, and the synthetic guard test adds prepared-review, later-note, ordinary-commit and resolved-conclusion controls.

Limit: this preserves an existing principal DELIVER and records the review paths a prepared merge added. It still cannot create a delivery for a project with no prior DELIVER, and operator acceptance plus the canonical-head decision remain outside the product.
